method: Selected Max cast with normal ranked resources. Initial boss/player placements and phase/rotation are fixture setup only. After cast, only actual directional inputs are used at30/60Hz; no attacks, Space, E/R, HP edits, invulnerability edits, teleports, hazard deletion or cooldown cheats. Each visible fixed aim/return cue or domain phase requires the specified reaction delay before following the public guide.
limitations: Geometry-aware input policies, not measured human success rates.
Isolated route tests do not measure five-boss resource attrition; full challenge and fresh-resource duels report that separately.

additionalRandomRoutes.method: 400 additional .35-second walking-only fixtures over50 deterministic random player/boss placements with at least150px initial separation, both roles and30/60Hz; phase alternates by sample. No state edits after the initial cast.
